# What stems can do

Every capability of stems, by area: what it does, the commands that use it,
the `stems.yaml` keys that configure it (`*` is any stem, list item or script
name) and the page that documents it. The same table is printed by
`stems features` (`--json` for agents, `stems features <area>` for one area)

## Running the environment

`stems features lifecycle`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Start and stop](lifecycle.md#commands) | Start everything, or some stems and their dependencies, in dependency order (attached or detached); stop in reverse order. | `stems up`, `stems down`, `stems start`, `stems stop`, `stems restart` | `stems`, `stems.*.stop_grace` |
| [Stem types](getting-started.md#4-add-your-services) | Local processes, docker containers, compose services, and external endpoints stems only health-checks. | `stems up`, `stems show` | `stems.*.type`, `stems.*.command`, `stems.*.cwd`, `stems.*.shell` |
| [Dependency graph](lifecycle.md#readiness) | `depends_on` with readiness conditions (started, healthy, seeded) and soft edges; `stems graph` draws it or exports Mermaid, DOT or JSON. | `stems graph`, `stems up` | `stems.*.depends_on`, `stems.*.depends_on.*.condition`, `stems.*.depends_on.*.soft` |
| [Cascading restarts](restart.md#cascading-restarts-fr-lc-9) | Restarting a stem can restart its dependants, edge by edge (`protocol`, `cascade`). | `stems restart` | `stems.*.restart.cascade`, `stems.*.depends_on.*.protocol` |
| [Disabled stems](config.md#enabled) | `enabled: false` or `enabled: "${env.X}"` keeps a stem out of `up`; it shows as disabled, and `if_disabled` says what its dependants do. | `stems status`, `stems show` | `stems.*.enabled`, `stems.*.depends_on.*.if_disabled` |
| [Crash recovery and orphans](recovery.md) | A restarted daemon re-adopts the stems still running; leftovers of a crashed run are found and stopped or adopted. | `stems up`, `stems down`, `stems doctor` | - |
| [Process supervision](process-model.md) | Every process runs in its own process group; stops signal the whole group and pids are verified against reuse. | `stems stop`, `stems down` | `stems.*.stop_grace`, `stems.*.stdin` |

## Configuring a workspace

`stems features config`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Scaffold and validate](getting-started.md#1-create-an-integration-repo) | `stems init` scaffolds an integration repo (`--from` an example); `stems validate` reports every config error with its file and line. | `stems init`, `stems validate` | `schema_version`, `name` |
| [Resolved config](config.md) | `stems show` prints the merged, substituted config (`--effective` adds the defaults applied; secrets redacted). | `stems show` | `vars`, `stems.*.description`, `stems.*.tags` |
| [Profiles](config.md#profiles-fr-ws-8) | Named subsets of stems (`stems up --profile backend`), a default profile and strict mode. | `stems profiles`, `stems up` | `profiles`, `default_profile`, `strict_profiles`, `profile` |
| [Variants](config.md#variants-fr-st-8) | Alternative forms of a stem (a local process or a container); `stems switch` picks one, `stems show --variant` shows where each field comes from. | `stems switch`, `stems show` | `stems.*.variants`, `stems.*.variant`, `stems.*.inherit` |
| [Configurations](config.md#configurations) | Named overlays with the shape of stems.local.yaml (variants, disabled stems, env, profile) a team can share and select. | `stems configuration`, `stems configuration list`, `stems configuration use`, `stems configuration save` | `configurations`, `default_configuration`, `configuration` |
| [Local overrides](config.md#stems-config-getsetunset-fr-cl-5) | Per-developer changes in a gitignored stems.local.yaml, edited by hand or with `stems config set` (comments kept). | `stems config get`, `stems config set`, `stems config unset` | - |
| [Include and extends](config.md#include--extends-fr-ws-9) | Split a workspace over several files, or build on a shared base file. | `stems show` | `include`, `extends` |
| [Reload on change](config.md#reload-on-change-fr-wd-3) | The daemon notices config edits and plans what to restart; `stems config diff` shows the plan, `stems config apply` runs it. | `stems config diff`, `stems config apply` | `config`, `config.reload.auto_apply` |

## Environment, ports and outputs

`stems features env`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Environment and env files](config.md#environment-fr-st-4) | Workspace and stem `env`, `env_files` (optional with `required: false`), a documented precedence and a warning when a value is shadowed. | `stems env`, `stems show` | `env`, `stems.*.env`, `stems.*.env_files`, `stems.*.env_files.*.required` |
| [Secrets and redaction](config.md#secrets) | Secret env values are redacted in `show`, `env`, logs, exports and MCP; name patterns are adjustable. | `stems show`, `stems env`, `stems logs` | `secrets`, `redaction`, `stems.*.secrets` |
| [Ports](ports.md) | Named host ports, `auto` allocation, conflict checks and `${stem.<name>.port.<port>}` variables; `stems ports` lists them all. | `stems ports` | `stems.*.ports`, `stems.*.ports.*.name` |
| [Outputs](config.md#outputs-fr-st-6) | Values a stem publishes (static templates or commands, optionally secret) for other stems to consume. | `stems outputs` | `stems.*.outputs` |
| [Commands in a stem's context](exec.md) | `stems exec` runs a command with a stem's env and cwd (or in its container), `stems shell` opens a shell there, `stems env` prints the env. | `stems exec`, `stems shell`, `stems env` | `stems.*.scripts.*.inherit_env` |

## Scripts, hooks and overlays

`stems features scripts`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Lifecycle hooks](scripts.md#the-lifecycle-order) | Fixed `scripts:` names stems runs itself (setup, seed, pre_start, post_stop, ...) in lifecycle order; `stems scripts --lifecycle` lists them. | `stems scripts`, `stems run` | `scripts`, `stems.*.scripts` |
| [Custom scripts](scripts.md#custom-scripts-and-stems-run) | Any other script name, run with `stems run` (typed arguments, preconditions such as `requires_stopped`, timeouts, retries). | `stems run`, `stems scripts` | `stems.*.scripts.*.args`, `stems.*.scripts.*.requires`, `stems.*.scripts.*.requires_stopped`, `stems.*.scripts.*.timeout` |
| [Stamps](scripts.md#stamps-fr-sc-5) | `setup` and `seed` run once until their inputs change; `stems stamps` shows or clears the stamps, `stems reset` starts over. | `stems stamps`, `stems reset` | `stems.*.scripts.*.inputs`, `stems.*.scripts.*.stamp_env` |
| [Soft-failing setup](scripts.md#partial-installs-soft_fail) | `soft_fail: true` lets a stem start degraded when an optional setup step fails. | `stems status` | `stems.*.scripts.*.soft_fail` |
| [Builds](scripts.md#build-in-the-start-sequence-when) | `stems build` runs build scripts or docker builds; `when:` puts a build into the start sequence. | `stems build`, `stems restart` | `stems.*.scripts.*.when`, `stems.*.build` |
| [Overlays](overlays.md) | Templated files stems writes into a codebase before start (never into tracked files); `stems overlays render` renders them on demand. | `stems overlays`, `stems overlays render` | `stems.*.overlays` |

## Docker and compose

`stems features containers`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Docker stems](docker.md) | Containers named and labelled per workspace, registry credentials from `docker login`, adopted after a daemon restart; `stems pull` refreshes images. | `stems pull`, `stems up` | `stems.*.image`, `stems.*.pull`, `stems.*.volumes`, `stems.*.network`, `stems.*.entrypoint`, `stems.*.labels`, `stems.*.healthcheck` |
| [Docker builds](docker.md#build-secrets-and-paths-outside-the-context-buildx) | Build images from a context and Dockerfile, with build secrets and paths outside the context. | `stems build` | `stems.*.build.context`, `stems.*.build.dockerfile`, `stems.*.build.secrets`, `stems.*.build.allow_read` |
| [Compose stems](compose.md) | One service of a compose file as a stem: built by default, stale images reported, the stem's env injected with `inject_env`. | `stems up`, `stems doctor` | `stems.*.file`, `stems.*.service`, `stems.*.project_name`, `stems.*.adopt`, `stems.*.inject_env`, `stems.*.build.services` |
| [Compose passthrough](compose.md) | `stems compose <stem> -- <args>` runs `docker compose` with the stem's file, project and env (migrations, `run --rm`, `ps`). | `stems compose` | - |

## Health and supervision

`stems features supervision`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Health checks](health.md#probe-types) | HTTP, TCP and command probes with retries, start periods and flapping detection; `stems health` shows the last results. | `stems health`, `stems status` | `stems.*.health` |
| [Status](lifecycle.md#checking-states-in-scripts-status---expect) | One status model for every stem (healthy, degraded, failed, ...); `stems status --expect` waits for a state in scripts. | `stems status` | - |
| [Restart policies](restart.md#policies) | Restart on failure with backoff, a restart window and `on_unhealthy`; the output tail of a failure is kept. | `stems status`, `stems restart` | `stems.*.restart` |
| [Watchdogs](watchdogs.md) | File watchers that restart or rebuild a stem, run a script or signal it on change; pause and resume them. | `stems watch pause`, `stems watch resume`, `stems watch status` | `stems.*.watch` |

## Logs, events, metrics and the dashboard

`stems features observe`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Logs](logs.md#stems-logs) | Captured stem and script logs, merged or per stem, followed live, with levels detected, rotation and retention. | `stems logs` | `logs` |
| [Bug-report bundle](logs.md#export-bundle) | `stems logs --export` writes status, events, redacted config and log files into one .tar.gz. | `stems logs` | - |
| [Events](protocol.md#events) | A structured event log of every state change and action (with its actor); `stems events -f --json` streams it as NDJSON. | `stems events` | - |
| [Metrics](metrics.md) | CPU, memory, children and disk per stem with sparklines and thresholds. | `stems metrics` | `metrics`, `stems.*.limits` |
| [Dashboard](tui.md) | A terminal dashboard: table, graph, logs, events and scripts views, with every action one key away. | `stems attach`, `stems up` | - |
| [Desktop notifications](notifications.md) | One OS notification when stems fail for good (or your own command). | - | `notifications` |

`stems features doctor`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Doctor](doctor.md#checks) | Diagnose the machine and the workspace: Docker, tool versions, ports, orphans; `--fix` repairs what it can. | `stems doctor` | - |

## Code from git

`stems features repos`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Git codebases](repos.md) | A `codebase:` can be a git URL: stems clones and fetches it; `stems repos status` shows where each one is. | `stems repos sync`, `stems repos status` | `repos_dir`, `stems.*.codebase` |
| [Checking out a ref](repos.md) | `stems repos checkout <stem> <ref>` switches a stem's codebase to a branch, tag or commit. | `stems repos checkout` | - |

## Agents and automation

`stems features agents`

| Feature | What it does | Commands | Config keys |
|---|---|---|---|
| [MCP server](mcp.md) | Agents start, stop, inspect and script the environment over MCP; custom scripts become tools, destructive calls are gated. | `stems mcp` | `agent` |
| [JSON everywhere](cli.md) | Every command takes `--json` (one envelope, stable error codes and exit codes). | - | - |
| [Daemon protocol](protocol.md) | One daemon per workspace owns the stems; its local JSON-RPC socket is documented for your own tools. | `stems daemon`, `stems daemon start`, `stems daemon stop`, `stems daemon status` | - |
| [Feature index](features.md) | This table: `stems features [--json] [<area>]`; `stems docs [<topic>]` prints the reference pages. | `stems features`, `stems docs` | - |

## Top-level keys of `stems.yaml`

The comment block of a `stems init` template lists the same keys.

| Key | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `schema_version` | config format version (1) |
| `name` | workspace name (default: the directory name) |
| `vars` | named values for `${var.<name>}` |
| `env` | environment for every stem (a stem's `env` wins) |
| `requires` | tool versions every developer needs (`stems doctor`) |
| `checks` | your own checks, run by `stems doctor` and before `up` |
| `profiles` | named subsets of stems (`stems up --profile <name>`) |
| `default_profile` | profile `up` uses when none is given |
| `strict_profiles` | never start stems outside the selected profile |
| `profile` | this machine's profile (stems.local.yaml) |
| `agent` | guard rails for MCP clients (`stems mcp`) |
| `logs` | log rotation and retention |
| `metrics` | metrics sampling |
| `config` | how the daemon handles config edits (`config.reload`) |
| `notifications` | desktop notifications when stems fail for good |
| `secrets` | env names whose values are secret (redacted) |
| `redaction` | adjust the built-in secret name patterns |
| `repos_dir` | where git codebases are cloned |
| `scripts` | workspace scripts (`bootstrap`, `teardown`, custom) |
| `include` | extra YAML files merged into this one |
| `extends` | a base workspace file merged underneath this one |
| `configurations` | named, shareable overlays (`stems configuration`) |
| `default_configuration` | configuration used when none is selected |
| `configuration` | this machine's configuration (stems.local.yaml) |
| `stems` | the stems, keyed by name |
